title: Italian Frittata
description: A classic Italian dish made with eggs, vegetables, and cheese, perfect for a quick and easy breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the bell peppers and mushrooms over medium heat until tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the vegetables in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Slice into wedges and serve hot.
